answers.explanation: The public task omits movement constants, and packet assumptions explicitly supply gravity 0.035, speed 0.18, jump impulse 0.34, radius 0.35, height 1, foot-anchor start and recovery bounds. The 30 FPS jump trace goes from tick 10 (y=2, grounded) to tick 11 (y=2.305, airborne), then lands at tick 29. Representative checkpoint raw traces at all three rates show fall below y=-3.8 followed by restore to the captured checkpoint at tick 63; the source collision/resolution and reset code implements those assumptions. This is bounded-model evidence, not fidelity to an unspecified commercial physics engine.

All concrete obligations are supported locally: records/index.json lists move/jump/checkpoint captures at 30/60/144 FPS with two repeats; representative raw checkpoint traces at each rate include five recovery transitions, and platform-behavior.json includes jump/landing and checkpoint/recovery witness summaries. The three supplied screenshots show capsule/platform/checkpoint alignment. Physics and coordinate assumptions are explicit in packet.json.

The jump trace has grounded-to-airborne and airborne-to-grounded transitions; source emits JUMP for grounded jump and LAND only on transition from airborne to grounded. Checkpoint traces at 30, 60 and 144 FPS each show five restore transitions and matching COLLIDE events, e.g. 30 FPS tick 62->63 in evidence/records/11-gd-071.public-native-scenario-checkpoint-30-0.json#actual.state and #actual.events. The native model is not itself an independent semantic oracle; these raw traces are checked against the declared model assumptions.

Collision/checkpoint recovery is relevant and witnessed at all requested rates: representative raw checkpoint captures at 30/60/144 each contain five restore transitions and corresponding COLLIDE events; evidence/platform-behavior.json#rows supplies the broader summary. Capsule alignment is visual evidence, separate from events. State/event/input/terminal consistency is supported for the supplied fixtures and declared assumptions.
